channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PF quer mais tempo para concluir investigação contra Monark
item.description: The Federal Police requested Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the STF to extend the deadline to conclude an investigation against influencer Monark for alleged disobedience to judicial decisions. The PF cited technical limitations in the STF’s system that prevented full analysis of files within the initial 30-day period, but stated the team is now aligned and in an advanced phase of work. The investigation began after the January 8, 2023 attacks, when Monark’s profiles were blocked for allegedly inciting the coup attempts.

item.title: Governo pede e relator adia parecer sobre marco dos minerais críticos
item.description: Relator Arnaldo Jardim postponed the report on the Critical Minerals Regulatory Framework at the request of the Lula government, which seeks to include the creation of the state-owned Terrabras and export restrictions. This is the second delay, with the report now set for May 4, amid remote voting sessions and ongoing negotiations among ministries and the Civil House to establish centralized governance.

item.title: Revisão do papel dos militares, reforma no STF e aliança com a direita: PT detalha propostas para novo programa
item.description: The PT has unveiled a proposal to update its party program for the 8th National Congress, advocating for broad institutional reforms, including a reassessment of the military's role, STF reform with ethics and conduct codes, and countering economic capture of the political system. Coordinated by José Dirceu, the document will be voted on between April 24 and 26 and will guide the party’s stance in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Filiada ao Podemos, Luisa Mell esclarece planos de candidatura em 2026
item.description: Activist Luisa Mell joined the Podemos party in March 2026 and was appointed National Ambassador for Animal Defense, aiming to strengthen the party's work on animal protection through the 'Podemos Animal' initiative. She explicitly denied running for office in the 2026 elections, stating her role is to unite animal protection lawmakers and pass stricter laws against violent crimes against animals. Mell had previously attempted to enter politics in 2024 as a city council candidate for União Brasil in São Paulo but withdrew.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro, Zema e as críticas ao STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro will use his participation in the Norte Show, an agribusiness event in Sinop (MT), to publicly support Romeu Zema’s criticisms of the Supreme Federal Court (STF). The move reinforces the alliance between Bolsonarist figures and opposition governors against the STF, amid growing tensions between Brazil’s branches of government. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: Possível desfalque na Copa, Estêvão lidera números da seleção brasileira com Ancelotti; veja
item.description: Brazilian forward Estêvão, 18, suffered a grade four right thigh injury during Chelsea's loss to Manchester United, potentially ruling him out of the 2026 World Cup. Since Carlo Ancelotti's arrival as Brazil's head coach, Estêvão has been the team's top scorer with five goals in seven matches, also leading in goal involvements, shots on target, and accurate crosses, according to Sofascore data.

item.title: Eleitores de Lula e de Bolsonaro dividem uma opinião sobre a Copa, segundo Datafolha
item.description: Datafolha survey shows 54% of Brazilians have no interest in following the 2026 World Cup, the highest level since 1994, with 31% saying they won’t watch any match. Despite political polarization, disinterest is nearly identical among Lula voters (51%) and Bolsonaro supporters (56%), within margin of error. The decline is attributed to poor team performance, shifting habits, and symbolic rejection of football, with stronger disengagement among women (62%) and relatively higher interest among youth.

item.title: Provocar Trump vira jogo eleitoral de Lula, dizem analistas
item.description: Analysts interpret Lula’s ironic remarks about Trump during his European trip as a domestic electoral strategy aimed at bolstering internal support by positioning Trump as a symbolically rejected figure in Brazil. Economists warn that this confrontational tone toward the U.S., amid high inflation and interest rates, raises institutional and economic risks, potentially increasing volatility and limiting room for monetary easing. Combined with Middle East tensions and the Marcelo Ivo case, the episode amplifies uncertainty and is seen as primarily political rather than diplomatic or economic in intent.

item.title: Lula convoca ministros para discutir impasse sobre “estatal dos minerais críticos”
item.description: President Lula convened a ministerial meeting to address the impasse over the creation of the state-owned company Terrabras in the National Strategic and Critical Minerals Policy bill (PL 2780/2024), after rapporteur Arnaldo Jardim rejected its inclusion and refused to compromise. The government is negotiating alternative instruments such as promotion mechanisms and guarantee fund resources, while seeking to delay the Chamber vote to refine its position. The bill is considered a priority for Brazil’s energy transition and economic sovereignty, aiming to exploit the global window to reduce dependence on Chinese mineral supplies.

item.title: Moro critica PSD e diz ser o maior “adversário” de Lula no Paraná
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL), a pre-candidate for governor of Paraná, criticized the PSD for its 'dubious' stance in occasionally aligning with President Lula and questioned the party's silence on alleged excesses of the Supreme Federal Court. Moro positioned himself as Lula's main adversary in the state.

item.title: Flamengo x Vitória na Copa do Brasil: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Flamengo and Vitória face off this Wednesday (22) at 9:30 PM Brasília time at Maracanã, in the first leg of the Copa do Brasil round of 16. Flamengo arrives on a five-match winning streak but will be without injured Lucas Paquetá, while Vitória misses Gabriel Baralhas and Renato Kayzer due to injury. The match will be broadcast on Sportv and Premiere, refereed by Anderson Daronco.

item.title: Fachin barra tentativa de afastar Mendonça de ação contra indicação de Messias ao STF
item.description: Supreme Federal Court President Edson Fachin rejected a request to declare Minister André Mendonça biased in a case urging the court to order President Lula to prioritize nominations from historically segregated ethnic-racial and gender profiles. The case, for which Mendonça is the rapporteur, seeks to block the nomination of Jorge Messias to the seat vacated by Luís Roberto Barroso. Fachin ruled that public expressions of support by Mendonça for Messias do not meet the legal threshold for bias.

item.title: Diretor-geral da PF diz que retirou credenciais de agente dos EUA por 'reciprocidade'
item.description: The director-general of the Federal Police, Andrei Rodrigues, confirmed he withdrew diplomatic credentials from a U.S. official in retaliation for the U.S. decision to remove Brazilian Federal Police delegate Marcelo Ivo de Carvalho from American territory. The move follows President Lula’s statement that Brazil would reciprocate any abuse of authority or interference by the U.S. government. The delegate, who participated in the arrest of former congressman Alexandre Ramagem in the U.S. in April, has returned to Brazil at the PF’s request.

item.title: CCJ da Câmara vota fim da escala 6×1 nesta quarta-feira; acompanhe ao vivo
item.description: The Chamber’s Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) resumes voting on ending the 6×1 work schedule this Wednesday, with rapporteur Paulo Azi (União-BA) advocating an intermediate 5×2, 40-hour weekly proposal that preserves wages. Chamber President Hugo Motta backs swift approval of PEC 8/2025, aiming to bring it to the plenary by end of May, while the Lula administration frames the reform as a political asset for his re-election bid.

item.title: Caso Ramagem: governo Lula retalia EUA e retira credenciais de oficial americano no Brasil
item.description: The Brazilian government revoked the credentials of a U.S. agent in response to the detention of former deputy Alexandre Ramagem in the U.S., where he sought political asylum after being convicted for involvement in the 'coup plot'. The move was announced by Federal Police Director Andrei Rodrigues as reciprocity for the removal of the PF attaché in Miami. Ramage, former Abin director, was detained by ICE in Orlando and released two days later without an official explanation from U.S. authorities.

item.title: Proposta sobre escala 6×1 vira trunfo eleitoral de Lula e impõe um dilema à oposição
item.description: The proposal to end the 6×1 work schedule is likely to pass Congress due to strong public support and improved government-Legislature relations, despite criticism over the lack of economic debate. The government is using it as a political asset to reduce disapproval and gain votes, putting the opposition in a dilemma: opposing it risks electoral backlash, while amending it to accommodate business interests may be their only viable path.

item.title: Os fiscais de Carlos Bolsonaro
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro announced the monitoring of allies' social media to pressure those not yet supporting his brother Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 presidential pre-candidacy. However, the move backfired, exposing the weakness of internal support and revealing divisions within the Bolsonarist base.

item.title: Mais uma candidata a vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) have begun advocating for Fortaleza city councilwoman and Senate pre-candidate Priscila Costa (PL-CE) as the vice-presidential running mate on Bolsonaro’s ticket. The move aims to strengthen outreach to the Northeast and reduce Flávio Bolsonaro’s rejection among voters in the region. The report was first published by G1 and later featured on O Antagonista.

item.title: Governo de SP libera R$ 276,6 milhões para turismo paulista
item.description: The São Paulo state government has released R$ 276.6 million for 214 tourist municipalities, allocating R$ 195 million to the 78 tourist resorts (R$ 2.5 million each) and R$ 81.6 million to the 136 Tourist Interest Municipalities (R$ 600 thousand each). The funds will be transferred via agreements with the State Secretariat for Government and Institutional Relations, aiming to expedite tourism-related investments and strengthen local governance through Municipal Tourism Councils (COMTURs).

item.title: Ao vivo: Câmara vota criação de política de minerais críticos
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies is voting, starting at 2 p.m. this Wednesday (April 22, 2026), on Bill No. 2.780/2024, which establishes the National Policy on Critical and Strategic Minerals. The bill also proposes creating a committee linked to the National Mineral Policy Council to promote sustainable research, extraction, processing, and industrial development of these minerals. The initiative aligns with recent actions by the Lula administration, including international agreements and the formation of councils to manage strategic mineral resources.

item.title: CCJ do Senado volta atrás e sabatina de Jorge Messias será no dia 29
item.description: The Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) has rescheduled the hearing for Jorge Messias, the Attorney General of the Union nominated by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for a seat on the Supreme Federal Court (STF), to Wednesday, the 29th. The change follows an initial postponement, reflecting internal political negotiations within the committee.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: cientista político vê efeito-Trump como possível fator de desempate nas pesquisas
item.description: Political scientist Rafael Cortez argues that Donald Trump's prominence could be a decisive factor in Brazil's 2026 election, benefiting Lula by linking Bolsonarismo to a polarizing U.S. figure and increasing rejection of Flávio Bolsonaro. He notes that events like the U.S. tariff spike have already aided Lula's political recovery, and the Bolsonarist strategy of aligning with Trump may backfire, making the 'Trump effect' a potential tie-breaker in a tight race.

item.title: “Irei até o final”, diz Zema sobre possibilidade de apoio a Flávio
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) reiterated his intention to stay in the presidential race until the end, responding to a question from presenter Thimoteo Oliveira about the point of supporting him. Zema stated he will not withdraw his candidacy, despite speculation about a possible endorsement of Flávio Dino.

item.title: Fala irônica sobre Trump expõe plano de Lula, mas efeito-Ramagem empolga oposição
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva intensified his criticism of Donald Trump during a trip to Europe, using the international confrontation as a domestic political strategy to strengthen his image as a defender of dialogue and peace. This tougher rhetoric aims to unite his electoral base by associating Trump with his main domestic rival, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, amid a tight election scenario. Meanwhile, the case involving former deputy Alexandre Ramagem, whose removal from the U.S. Lula labeled as American abuse, ended up bolstering the opposition’s bolsonarist narrative.

item.title: Caiado escolhe ex-ministro de FHC para elaborar plano de governo à Presidência
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) has appointed former minister Roberto Brant to coordinate the development of his 2026 presidential government plan. Brant, who served as Minister of Social Security and Assistance under Fernando Henrique Cardoso and was a federal deputy for 20 years, is a critic of the Lula government and advocates overcoming political polarization. Caiado also criticized the PT and questioned the experience of Flávio Bolsonaro as the PL's presidential candidate.

item.title: Por desespero eleitoral, Lula ataca Trump. Mas só dará certo se o americano reagir
item.description: Lula seeks to regain popularity by attacking Trump following the expulsion of a Brazilian PF delegate from the U.S., reviving a rhetoric of victimhood against global imperialism that previously boosted his approval. The strategy hinges on Trump reacting truculently to ignite Brazilian public opinion, but is seen as desperate given their prior rapport and an already scheduled in-person meeting.

item.title: Com Lula em 7º, veja o ranking dos presidentes mais populares da América Latina
item.description: President Lula ranks 7th in Latin America's most popular presidents, with 48.4% positive image, according to CB Consultora Opinión Pública. Nayib Bukele (El Salvador) leads with 70.1%, followed by Claudia Sheinbaum (Mexico) at 69.1%. Javier Milei (Argentina) dropped to 14th with only 36.2% approval.

item.title: Lançado na Espanha, álbum da Copa não tem figurinha de Neymar
item.description: Panini launched the 2026 World Cup sticker album in Spain without including Neymar among Brazil's 28 players, marking his first absence in four consecutive World Cup editions if confirmed. The exclusion also applies to the 'Adrenalyn XL' card game. The album contains 980 stickers, with individual packs priced at R$ 7 and a special edition at R$ 359.90, while completing the set may cost over R$ 7,000. A Datafolha poll indicates 53% of Brazilians support Neymar's inclusion in the 2026 squad.

item.title: STF tem 3 votos pela condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro por difamar Tabata
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) has three votes in favor of convicting Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) for defamation against Deputy Tabata Amaral (PSB-SP), stemming from statements made in 2021 about a sanitary pad distribution bill. The vote, under the rapporteurship of Minister Alexandre de Moraes, is taking place in a virtual plenary and is expected to conclude on Tuesday, April 28, 2026. So far, Moraes, Cármen Lúcia, and Flávio Dino have voted for conviction, with no votes for acquittal.

item.title: UE revela planos para enfrentar a crise energética causada por guerra no Oriente Médio
item.description: The European Union unveiled a 'fuel observatory' and a 'toolbox' to monitor and mitigate the energy crisis triggered by the war in the Middle East, with an initial focus on aviation fuel, as 20% of the EU's consumption depends on imports via the Strait of Hormuz. Measures include coordinating alternative sources, optimizing distribution, assessing flexibility in airport slot rules, and considering minimum reserves and increased U.S. imports. The European Commission stated there is no evidence of real shortages but is preparing structural responses for citizens and businesses.

item.title: Estêvão sofre lesão grave na coxa e deve ficar de fora da Copa do Mundo de 2026
item.description: Brazilian forward Estêvão of Chelsea suffered a grade four thigh injury during the match against Manchester United, making his participation in the 2026 World Cup highly unlikely. The injury is expected to end his debut season at Chelsea, where he had eight goals and four assists in 36 appearances. Brazil already lost Rodrygo to injury ahead of the tournament.

item.title: A próxima pesquisa Nexus com as intenções de voto para a Presidência
item.description: The Nexus institute will release on Monday, April 27, a new presidential voting intention poll based on 2,000 interviews conducted between April 21 and 26, with a two-point margin of error. Commissioned by BTG Pactual, the survey will test three first-round scenarios (including one without Romeu Zema) and three second-round scenarios, all featuring Lula, while also updating Lula’s government approval ratings.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Quaest sobre a eleição para o governo do Rio de Janeiro
item.description: Quaest will release on Monday, April 27, a new poll on the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial election, based on 1,200 interviews conducted from April 21 to 25 with a three-point margin of error. The state faces institutional uncertainty, with Rio de Janeiro Tribunal of Justice President Ricardo Couto serving as interim governor while the STF deliberates on whether a supplemental election will be held. The survey will test three first-round scenarios and project a runoff between Eduardo Paes (PSD) and Douglas Ruas (PL), while also updating presidential voting intentions.

item.title: Estêvão sofre lesão grau quatro na coxa e pode ficar de fora da Copa do Mundo, diz jornal
item.description: Brazilian forward Estêvão of Chelsea suffered a grade four thigh injury in his right leg during a Premier League match against Manchester United, casting doubt on his availability for the 2026 World Cup. The injury occurred early in the match during a counter-attack sprint, and an MRI confirmed the severity. This marks his second major muscle injury this season, following a left-leg issue earlier in the year that kept him out of Brazil friendlies.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Volta do feriado tem redução de jornada na CCJ da Câmara
item.description: Lula returned from Europe after criticizing Trump and the Middle East war, stating the world faces the highest number of conflicts since WWII and joking that Trump should win the Nobel Peace Prize to stop wars. In the Chamber of Deputies, the CCJ is set to vote today on the admissibility of a PEC to reduce the workweek, following the Tiradentes holiday. The 2026 electoral context is evident, with Lula reinforcing national sovereignty amid Flávio Bolsonaro’s rising poll numbers and concerns about foreign interference in Brazilian elections.

item.title: Minha Casa Minha Vida: Saiba o que muda com as novas regras do programa
item.description: The Minha Casa Minha Vida program was updated on April 22, 2026, raising the income ceiling to R$13,000 and the maximum financed property value to R$600,000, with revised income brackets and interest rates. The changes benefit previously excluded families, adding 31,300 new beneficiaries in bracket 3 and 8,200 in bracket 4 (middle class), and are part of a R$20 billion budget expansion for 2026 announced by President Lula.

item.title: Lula não deve 'comprar briga' com EUA antes de avaliar caso do delegado envolvido na prisão de Ramagem
item.description: Lula's advisors urge caution in responding to the U.S. expulsion of Federal Police delegate Marcelo Ivo de Carvalho, who was involved in the arrest of Alexandre Ramagem, awaiting official clarification before considering reciprocity measures. They stress that no formal communication has yet come from the U.S. government and that any political or ideological bias in the case must be confirmed before a stronger reaction is warranted.

item.title: Moro fica em último na liberação de emendas entre senadores do Paraná
item.description: Sérgio Moro has the lowest execution rate of individual imposing amendments among Paraná senators, despite having the same authorized funding (R$ 212.2 million between 2024 and 2026) as his peers. He trails Flávio Arns and Oriovisto Guimarães in all stages of budget execution over the last three years, according to a new analysis based on the Siga Brasil system.

item.title: Você sabe o que é sufrágio universal? O Glossário explica
item.description: The TSE's Electoral Glossary defines universal suffrage as the right to vote without restrictions, except in cases of civil incapacity or suspension of political rights, guaranteed to every capable and registered citizen. The term suffrage also includes the right to be elected and to participate in the State’s organization and activities. The online resource features over 300 electoral law terms, enriched with historical context and bibliographic references.

item.title: Prisão de Ramagem, liberação, delegado da PF expulso: entenda a cronologia do caso
item.description: Former deputy Alexandre Ramagem was arrested in the U.S. in April 2025 for an expired visa and released two days later, sparking a diplomatic dispute with Brazil. The Trump administration expelled the Brazilian Federal Police delegate who assisted in the arrest without notifying Brazilian authorities. President Lula hinted at possible reciprocity but provided no specifics.

item.title: ELEIÇÕES 2026: ENTREVISTA COM RENAN SANTOS, PRÉ-CANDIDATO À PRESIDÊNCIA DA REPÚBLICA PELO MISSÃO
item.description: Renan Santos, pre-candidate for President of Brazil from the Missão party, gives an interview about his proposals and vision for Brazil in 2026. The interview content was not detailed in the provided text, but indicates an early-stage campaign disclosure.

item.title: Governo atua para adiar votação de projeto sobre terras raras na Câmara
item.description: The Lula government is seeking to delay the vote on the bill creating the National Policy for Critical and Strategic Minerals in the Chamber of Deputies, lobbying behind the scenes to include the proposal for a public company, Terrabras, in the debate over rare earths. The strategy aims to buy time to align ministerial positions and broaden discussion, as the bill's rapporteur, Deputy Arnaldo Jardim, has not yet issued his formal opinion. PT leaders in Congress are advocating for more deliberation time, criticizing the speed of the process.

item.title: CCJ da Câmara retoma análise do fim da escala 6x1 nesta quarta
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) resumes analysis this Wednesday of PEC 221/2019, which seeks to end the 6x1 work schedule and reduce the weekly workweek from 44 to 36 hours over ten years. Rapporteur Paulo Azi voted for the proposal's admissibility, while the government concurrently advances a constitutional urgency bill to cut the workweek to 40 hours within 45 days to avoid a plenary blockade. If approved, the PEC could trigger a special committee, with a process potentially lasting months.

item.title: Governo troca comando de Ministério do Empreendedorismo após crise no PSB
item.description: The government replaced the Minister of Entrepreneurship, Tadeu Alencar, with Paulo Pereira, both members of the PSB, following pressure from party president João Campos due to internal tensions caused by Alencar’s appointment. The change was formalized by Vice President Geraldo Alckmin while President Lula was abroad in Europe. Alencar stated he stepped down to avoid party conflicts and prioritize government unity.

item.title: Ana Paula Renault ganha carro híbrido plug-in na grande final do BBB 26; saiba como veículo funciona
item.description: Ana Paula Renault won BBB 26 and received, in addition to R$ 5.7 million in cash, a plug-in hybrid Geely EX5 EM-i, a model set to be manufactured in Brazil starting this year. The vehicle combines an electric motor and a combustion engine, offering up to 112 km of all-electric range and 1,300 km combined range, and can be charged via plug or charging stations. This technology reduces emissions and fuel costs in urban trips while ensuring extended range for longer journeys.

item.title: Saiba quem é Tatiana Alves Torres, delegada da PF escolhida para atuar no ICE após crise envolvendo prisão de Ramagem
item.description: Federal Police delegate Tatiana Alves Torres has been appointed to replace Marcelo Ivo de Carvalho as the liaison officer to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in Miami, following a diplomatic crisis triggered by the arrest of former deputy Alexandre Ramagem by U.S. immigration authorities. The appointment, formalized by a directive from Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues, aims to restore bilateral cooperation amid threats of reciprocity from the Lula government. Torres, a federal police delegate since 2002, has extensive experience in environmental, financial, and organized crime investigations, along with international training and fluency in English and French—key qualifications for the role.

item.title: Crusoé: Ex-marqueteiro de Lula alerta para “fogo amigo”
item.description: Former Lula campaign strategist João Santana warned in an Instagram video about the risk of "friendly fire" in Lula’s re-election bid. He cautioned that if Lula remains stagnant or declines in polls, he risks losing both 'light' voters and pragmatic supporters. The alert underscores the need to adjust strategy to avoid internal erosion and preserve his electoral base.

item.title: Quanto Lula gastou para alugar cruzeiros na COP30?
item.description: The Lula government spent at least 350.2 million reais to charter cruise ships used as accommodation during COP30, held in Belém in November 2025. The figure was disclosed in a document sent by the Civil House and reported by Metrópoles.

item.title: Agro ignora Lula e convida Flávio para evento no MT em ano eleitoral
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is the guest of honor at an agribusiness event in Sinop (MT), while President Lula (PT), his 2026 electoral rival, was not even invited, highlighting the sector’s growing distance from the federal government. The omission reflects the Planalto’s struggle to engage with key agribusiness factions, which increasingly back opposition figures. Taking place in an election year, the event underscores deepening rural polarization in Brazil.

item.title: Aliado de Flávio, Tarcísio critica polarização e acena para Zema
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas visited Ouro Preto on Tiradentes Day to receive Minas Gerais' highest honor, where he criticized the Lula government while also condemning political polarization and praising Governor Romeu Zema, signaling a potential realignment within Brazil's right wing.
